update.title: Update {{name}} to {{version}}?
update.adds: This version can do more than the installed one. Review what it adds.
update.adds-nothing: This version adds no access the installed one doesn’t have.
update.removed-intro: The new version no longer has these settings, so their saved values are deleted:

additions.egress-setting: Can now reach the host in its setting {{field}} (now {{host}})
additions.egress-setting-any: Can reach the host you enter in its setting {{field}}
additions.bridge-open: Can ask to open {{url}} in a new tab
additions.bridge-open-any-https: Can ask to open any https link, after the person confirms it (a sensitive scope)
additions.embed: Now opens inside the workspace instead of in a new tab
additions.action: Lets socios ask for its action {{action}} ({{tier}})
additions.action-changed: Changes its socio action {{action}} from {{from}} to {{tier}}
additions.always-ask-dropped: No longer shows the person’s card on every socio access request
additions.bridge-routes: Gets deep links: its own pages get workspace addresses
additions.secret_required: Asks for a new required secret {{name}}
additions.secret_optional: Asks for a new optional secret {{name}}
additions.service-secret: Gets the runtime secret {{name}} mounted into its service
additions.dataset_read: Needs a new dataset {{name}}, to read
additions.dataset_write: Needs a new dataset {{name}}, to read and write
additions.dataset-write: Can now write to the dataset {{name}}, which it only read
additions.webhook: Takes public {{method}} requests at {{path}}, with no sign-in
additions.webhook-limit: Takes larger or more frequent public requests at {{method}} {{path}}
additions.cpus: Requests {{to, number}} CPUs, up from {{from, number}}
additions.memory: Requests {{to, number}} MB of memory, up from {{from, number}} MB
additions.volume: Keeps data on a new or changed volume {{name}}

uninstall.title: Uninstall {{name}}?
uninstall.description-bundled: It is removed from this instance and nobody can open it. The rows it saved stay, and so do its datasets, the workspace’s: installing it again offers them back.
uninstall.description-service: Its service stops and is removed, with its volumes and its identity. The rows it saved stay, and so do its datasets, the workspace’s: installing it again offers them back.
uninstall.name: Plugin name
